snapshotSizing.note: These are raw dense-vector matrix sizes only. A frozen admitted 16,151-row snapshot is about 47.3 MiB FP32 (23.7 MiB FP16); reading all 219,998 currently populated canonical-column rows is about 644.5 MiB FP32. Neither requires copying a 22-GB database. Do not snapshot/train until writer and row provenance are proven; database/index overhead is separate.

latentProjectionSizing.note: Raw vector payloads only; excludes point payload metadata, Qdrant indexes/segments, Postgres row/index overhead, and backups. Candidate cohort still must be revision-qualified. Do not duplicate source text or summaries into payloads.

entrypoints.npmAeTrain: sveltekit-frontend/package.json -> py -3.13 ../python/train_latent_autoencoder.py; guarded candidate PyTorch trainer, still blocked before database access until canonical semantic input lineage is proven
entrypoints.candidateTrainer: python/train_latent_autoencoder.py; direct execution now exits 78 before imports, database access, training, or output writes while TRAINING_AUTHORITY_PROVEN is false
entrypoints.candidateDryRun: npm run ae:train:dry; invokes python/train_latent_autoencoder.py --plan-only and prints the 768-512-256-128 architecture/provenance gate with no database access or artifact writes
entrypoints.legacyTrainer: scripts/atlas/train-autoencoder-768-64.mjs; compatibility shim now reports the current candidate on dry-run and blocks the historical Qdrant/Redis implementation before service access
entrypoints.legacyQueueEntrypoint: sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/queue-autoencoder-training.mjs; separate historical queue path, not the approved candidate trainer

latent_128.candidateMeaning: learned bottleneck; historical column values may be legacy slice-derived

latent_64.candidateMeaning: normalized prefix of candidate latent_128; historical values are not relabeled

postgresDrizzleAlignment.schemaChange: NO_NEW_DATABASE_MIGRATION_AUTHORED_OR_APPLIED; existing physical declarations are mapped in Drizzle
postgresDrizzleAlignment.sourceModelWriter: sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/db/schema/search-analytics.ts was corrected to map historical content_embedding as halfvec(768) and declare the latent vector columns consistently

qdrantProjection.candidatePointSerializer: python/provision_qdrant_latent256.py::build_candidate_point; validates complete identity/provenance payload, exact dimensions, finite values, and unit norms; fixture-tested only

upsertContract.updateSemantics: FULL_POINT_REPLACEMENT; never omit an existing named vector or required payload field
upsertContract.targetCollection: NEW_VERSIONED_COLLECTION_REQUIRED; do not reuse legacy single-vector collection

qdrantProjection.payloadSchema: atlas.latent-qdrant-point-payload.v2; complete identity/provenance metadata plus per-named-vector and stable payload digests; large source/context text and duplicate vectors excluded; unversioned RFF/KMeans/topology tags excluded
qdrantProjection.payloadValuePolicy: identity and provenance metadata only; no vectors or large context blobs duplicated into payload
qdrantProjection.upsertStatus: BLOCKED; no training input provenance, candidate checkpoint, Postgres candidate-row readback, or admitted projection revision. Do not reuse the legacy 256-only collection or create a new collection until the collection revision and consumers are approved.
qdrantProjection.expectedOrder: canonical admitted Postgres inputs -> candidate output materialization/readback -> Qdrant batch upsert -> Qdrant identity/vector/payload readback

semanticWriterAudit.interpretation: Model labels and dimensions do not prove immutable per-row writer/input lineage; the training gate must remain closed.

rffClarification: scripts/atlas/backfill-graphify-rff-embeddings-768.mjs embeds Graphify error/signature text with EmbeddingGemma into separate error_embedding/signature_embedding columns; it is not a Random Fourier transform or an autoencoder stage. Its apply path can write PostgreSQL and was not run.
